'''Paetram Aybara''' was [[Perrin]]'s brother. His father and mother were [[Con Aybara]] and [[Joslyn Aybara]]. He also had two sisters, [[Adora]] and [[Deselle]]. He was nine.

==Activities==
[[Padan Fain]] murders Perrin's entire family, including Paetram but the death is blamed on Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|29}} Perrin often said that Paetram enjoyed climbing in the apple tree by their home.
